name: Ron Flockhart
features: lean angular face, dark hair swept back, reserved Scottish bearing, slim build
bio: Twice a Le Mans winner with Ecurie Ecosse, in 1956 and 1957, and BRM\u2019s Grand Prix driver through the P25 years. An engineer by training and a record-breaking aviator by inclination; he died in 1962 attempting to fly a Mustang from Sydney to London.
